title: KAITO — Idol Fan In SEKAI〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: The Lumina Forum - Bedroom

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see... I have to be aware of where all the cameras are...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes. Hikarin stood out among everyone on the stream today...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Obviously, that's partially because she's very good at making conversations fun.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But another reason seems to be that she has a talent for being in the right place at the right time as she springs into action for the cameras.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, whenever she jumped in front of the camera, it was always at the perfect time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We should be keeping track of where the stationary and staff cameras are. That way, we'll be able to effectively appeal to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That sounds really hard, but I'm gonna try my best!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <It's amazing how you're able to notice all these things, KAITO.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You give me too much credit. I just tend to think about the staff and equipment because I'm usually working behind the scenes.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for giving us all these different perspectives. We've been able to have a wonderful debrief as a result.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hehe. We're glad that we could help.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, I think we've done enough reflection. Let's start discussing our plan for tomorrow next.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Plan?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. In particular, how we're going to appeal to everyone watching.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right...
I realized today just how hard it is to do that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, since the people watching aren't exclusively our fans.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're mostly dealing with the fans of other groups and people who are interested in the program itself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why it's going to be crucial for us to make a good impression on them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But that doesn't mean just standing out.
We need to show them what MORE MORE JUMP! is all about...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm...
But what's the best way to actually do that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
There's no need to overcomplicate this.
First, let's begin by coming up with as many ideas as we can.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <In that case, what if you all tried seeing things from a fan's perspective to get a better idea of what would draw them in?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I can do that...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I think I can help as well.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, since you're SEKAI's number one idol fan!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Does anything come to mind that you'd like to see us do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Well, for instance...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'd like to see you interacting with more of the other idols. I have a feeling that we'll get to see a different side of you that we don't get to normally.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: People did post quite a lot of comments when we were with Hikarin and everyone from ReLight.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Exactly. And for the viewer, it's also a chance to get to learn about groups you've never encountered.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <If your favorite group began talking to another one, wouldn't you be inclined to learn more about them?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, yes, I understand exactly what you mean!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll start looking for information on who these idols are and end up falling in love with them in the process.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just another reason we should make an effort to talk to everyone.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <There's also how one of your biggest draws as a group is the close relationship you have with your fans. It'd be great to have the viewers see that...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <One way would be to do streams on your own channel separate from the program's.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... We were also thinking about doing that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The program's stream is mainly going to be about observing the training camp, so we should make a point of setting aside time to actually interact with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What do you think would get everyone to tune in to our stream?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Something you can only do at the training camp might be good.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, I agree. That's a great idea!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something we can only do here... Hmm... What if we went around to our favorite spots?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We could also report on the cafeteria's menu and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It'll be good to tell everyone while everything feels fresh and new.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, a peek into your private lives might also be fun...!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Their private lives?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Because they're going to be living here for a while!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Revealing how you spend each day would give you an opportunity to show things that you can't during your regular streams.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Which are precisely the kinds of things that fans can't get enough of!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Seeing something new will definitely introduce a new topic of conversation. At the very least, it'd get me talking...!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <So, I hope you all find a way to turn that into a stream!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I also have this other idea...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I-I'm sorry. I didn't mean to dominate the conversation like that.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But I'm just so excited about the grand prix that I couldn't help myself...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I think it's a wonderful expression of who you are, KAITO.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. What you just said is incredibly helpful.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please tell us this other idea of yours!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <O-Oh, okay.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <In that case, I'll continue. Where was I...?>
